prompt:
Deliverable: one chibi enemy battle sprite sheet, a single 16:9 landscape image holding exactly four separate full-body figures of the same creature, one image only. It is a game animation sheet; the reference images are numbered below the prompt.
SUBJECT: a Bellbound Dead, a slumped, thin hollow wired to a bell by its own chains, drawn in compact chibi proportion about 3.5 heads tall: a large head hanging low and forward on a thin, caved, vertically narrow body, long bony arms hanging down to its knees, and bare dirty-bone feet. Torn charcoal cloth hangs in rags from its shoulders and waist. A cold-brass bell (dull brown-bronze #66533E, no green patina) hangs on a short chain at the centre of its chest, and two thin dark iron chains run from that bell down to the wrists, one to each wrist and wrapped once around it, dividing the thin torso. Skin and bone are dirty bone, a dull grey-ivory darker than clean bone. The face is gaunt and pale with dark hollow eye sockets and a slack mouth, simplified like a mask, on a bare head. It is a frail hollow, not a knight: it wears no armour. Use reference image 1 for the silhouette and material of this creature. The body, cloth, bell and chains are identical in all four figures. It faces the left of the frame in every figure.
LAYOUT: four figures on one flat pure #00FF00 background, arranged in two columns and two rows. Imagine the canvas divided into four equal areas, each one half of the image width and one half of the image height, and place exactly one figure at the centre of each area. Reading order left to right, then top to bottom: top row 1 idle, 2 basic attack; bottom row 3 hit reaction, 4 defeat. All four figures are drawn at one identical scale, as four different poses of the same creature and not a turnaround: the standing idle figure is about 64% of the area height; the basic attack is the same height or within a tenth of it; the hit reaction is about 90% of it; the defeat figure is the smallest at about 55% of it. The lowest point of every figure (planted foot, knee or staff tip) rests on one shared horizontal baseline about 85% of the way down its area, with nothing hanging below it. Every figure, with its chains, bell, pack and staff, lies completely inside its own area and is separated from every neighbouring figure and from the image border by flat empty green at least as wide as twelve percent of one figure's width, so nothing touches or overlaps. Each prop stays physically attached to its figure. The sheet carries no grid lines, frames, numbers, captions, arrows, shadows or ground.
POSES, every figure facing the left of the frame in a three-quarter view: 1 idle: slumped and swaying, the knees slightly bent, the head hanging forward, the long arms hanging with the fingertips near the knees, the bell hanging at the chest and the chains slack between the bell and the wrists. 2 basic attack, Tolling Grab: lunging toward the left, the leading arm stretched far out in front at chest height with an open reaching hand, the wrist chain pulled taut from the chest bell, the bell tilted forward on its chain, the other arm trailing behind, the head thrust forward. 3 hit reaction: jolted backward to the right, head snapped back, both arms flung out, the bell swung sideways on its chain, eyes squeezed shut, mouth open. 4 defeat: crumpled onto its knees and folded forward with the head down and the hands on the ground, the bell resting on the ground in front of it and the chains lying slack.
STYLE: compact chibi game-sprite illustration in a dark gothic anime register, drawn with one uniform bold outline in deep ink (#120A18) about 2 to 3 percent of the figure height, closed shapes, flat two-tone cel shading with one small hard highlight per material, torn matte cloth suggested by a few short hatching strokes, simple bone shapes; flat colour areas only, no gradients, no airbrush, no gloss, no realistic anatomy rendering.
LIGHT AND PALETTE: the same soft light from the upper left on every figure with no cast shadows; charcoal cloth, dirty bone and cold brass in restrained low saturation, darkest value #0F0D11, never pure black, no red tint on the figure.
TECHNICAL: the background is flat pure #00FF00, one flat colour from edge to edge with no gradient, floor, vignette, shadow, glow, mist or particles; every figure has a crisp, hard, closed outline so it separates cleanly from the green; no green anywhere on the figures and no green rim light or reflection on cloth or metal; the bell stays brown-bronze; text-free.
Do not add: text, letters or numbers; grid lines or frames; ground shadows; a red glow; magic or impact effects; blood or gore; heavy armour; a detailed realistic skull; modern items; extra fingers or limbs; a second creature.
